derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding (1,845,791 ÷ 1,140,100,000, the 10-K cover's 1,140.1 million)

inputs.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, cover page
inputs.quote: As of November 5, 2026, there were 1,140.1 million shares of the registrant’s Common Stock outstanding.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of November 5, 2026, we had approximately 16,000 shareholders of record.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the FY2026 10-K cover count at November 5, 2026 (stated rounded, 1,140.1 million), the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: stated as approximate.
